question.problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}5z-4y+2x \\ 3y-2z+6x \\ 4z-8x-y\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, rewrite the order of the variables in the usual way:

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}2x-4y+5z \\ 6x+3y-2z \\ -8x-y+4z\end{aligned}]
$$

We require a $3\times 3$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2x-4y+5z \\ 6x+3y-2z \\ -8x-y+4z\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & 5 \\ 6 & 3 & -2 \\ -8 & -1 & 4\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2x-4y+5z \\ 6x+3y-2z \\ -8x-y+4z\end{aligned}].
$$

    Hence, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & 5 \\ 6 & 3 & -2 \\ -8 & -1 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$
